prompt_text:
Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that streams microphone audio and yields interim transcripts using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Option 2 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 3 — Cloud Speech streaming:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: streaming_recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-requests#streaming

Option 4 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Option 5 — Azure Speech Streaming:
  Service: Azure AI Speech streaming
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_continuous_recognition, recognized
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/how-to-recognize-speech

Option 6 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import os
import asyncio
import pyaudio # For microphone input
from deepgram import (
    DeepgramClient,
    DeepgramClientOptions,
    LiveTranscriptionEvents,
    LiveOptions,
)

# Configuration for PyAudio
FORMAT = pyaudio.paInt16
CHANNELS = 1
RATE = 16000 # Deepgram recommends 16000 Hz for optimal performance
CHUNK = 1024 # Buffer size for audio stream

async def stream_microphone_transcriptions():
    """
    Streams microphone audio to Deepgram and yields interim transcripts.

    Requires the DEEPGRAM_API_KEY environment variable to be set.
    """
    deepgram_api_key = os.getenv("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY")
    if not deepgram_api_key:
        raise ValueError("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY environment variable not set.")

    # 1. Setup Deepgram Client
    config: DeepgramClientOptions = DeepgramClientOptions(
        verbose=0 # Set to 1 for more verbose Deepgram SDK logging
    )
    client = DeepgramClient(deepgram_api_key, config)

    # 2. Setup Deepgram Live connection
    deepgram_live = client.listen.asynclive.v("1")

    # Queue to hold transcripts from the Deepgram callback
    transcript_queue = asyncio.Queue()

    # 3. Define Deepgram event handlers
    async def on_message(result, **kwargs):
        # We only care about interim results for this task
        if not result.is_final:
            transcript = result.channel.alternatives[0].transcript
            if transcript:
                await transcript_queue.put(transcript)

    async def on_error(error, **kwargs):
        print(f"Deepgram Error: {error}")

    async def on_close(*args, **kwargs):
        print("Deepgram Connection Closed.")

    # 4. Register event handlers
    deepgram_live.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Transcript, on_message)
    deepgram_live.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Error, on_error)
    deepgram_live.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Close, on_close)

    # 5. Connect to Deepgram
    print("Connecting to Deepgram...")
    await deepgram_live.start(LiveOptions(
        model="nova-2", # Using a specific Deepgram model optimized for speech
        encoding="linear16",
        sample_rate=RATE,
        channels=CHANNELS,
        interim_results=True, # Essential for yielding interim transcripts
        punctuate=True,
        language="en-US"
    ))
    print("Connected to Deepgram. Listening to microphone... Press Ctrl+C to stop.")

    # 6. Setup PyAudio for microphone input
    p_audio = pyaudio.PyAudio()
    audio_stream = p_audio.open(format=FORMAT,
                                channels=CHANNELS,
                                rate=RATE,
                                input=True,
                                frames_per_buffer=CHUNK)

    try:
        while True:
            # Read audio data from microphone
            audio_data = audio_stream.read(CHUNK)
            # Send audio data to Deepgram
            await deepgram_live.send_data(audio_data)

            # Check if there are any transcripts in the queue from the callback
            try:
                # Use non-blocking get to avoid blocking the audio sending loop
                transcript = transcript_queue.get_nowait()
                yield transcript
            except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
                pass # No new transcript yet, continue reading audio

            await asyncio.sleep(0.001) # Small sleep to allow context switching and Deepgram processing

    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nStopping transcription.")
    finally:
        # 7. Clean up resources
        await deepgram_live.finish()
        audio_stream.stop_stream()
        audio_stream.close()
        p_audio.terminate()
        print("Microphone and Deepgram connection closed.")
